from pathlib import Path
import tomllib, subprocess, hashlib
from packaging.tags import cpython_tags, compatible_tags
from packaging.utils import parse_wheel_filename
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

lock=tomllib.loads(Path('apps/api/uv.lock').read_text())
platforms=['macosx_15_0_arm64','macosx_14_0_arm64','macosx_13_0_arm64','macosx_12_0_arm64','macosx_11_0_arm64','macosx_11_0_universal2','macosx_10_9_universal2']
tags=list(cpython_tags((3,12),platforms=platforms))+list(compatible_tags((3,12),interpreter='cp312',platforms=platforms))
priorities={tag:i for i,tag in enumerate(tags)}
wheelhouse=Path('.local/wheels')
wheelhouse.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
selected=[]
for package in lock['package']:
    if package['name']=='agentforge-api':
        continue
    candidates=[]
    for wheel in package.get('wheels',[]):
        filename=wheel['url'].rsplit('/',1)[1]
        wheel_tags=parse_wheel_filename(filename)[3]
        score=min((priorities[t] for t in wheel_tags if t in priorities),default=None)
        if score is not None:
            candidates.append((score,wheel))
    assert candidates, 'No compatible wheel for '+package['name']
    selected.append(min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0])[1])
def download(wheel):
    path=wheelhouse/wheel['url'].rsplit('/',1)[1]
    subprocess.run(['curl','-4','--fail','--silent','--show-error','--location','--max-time','45','--retry','2','--output',str(path),wheel['url']],check=True)
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==wheel['hash'].split(':',1)[1], 'Checksum mismatch'
    return path.name
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
    for name in pool.map(download,selected):
        print('Verified '+name,flush=True)
print('All locked runtime dependencies downloaded and checksum verified.')
PY","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":2000}));
